bounded_model.enumeration: Enumerate all row permutations for ordinary cases (at most24), keeping stable event IDs and relation edges. Receipt/turn order is a separate history and is not permutable by default. Overflow is a separate parser-negative case.
bounded_model.production_bounds: Use compiled source bounds; current carrier16 rows/4000 characters and up to3 products are this export facts, not reusable global policy constants. Overflow fails before any financial mutation.

types.Money: integer minor units; precision/scale from pinned amount codec, no float NaN/Inf; harness50 units=5000 minor units only
types.Date: resolved call-calendar token with policy-validation result; unresolved language is a different tagged value
types.Revision: opaque nonempty equality token; never infer recency numerically
types.Act: Flat tagged union used by cases: common id,kind,targets,completion,polarity,source_ref; assert adds component/value; need adds component/role; aggregate adds total_minor/allocations/date; permission adds mode; confirm adds readback_id; question adds q; recipient adds affirmation.
types.Relation: {from_id,to_id,kind:correction|supersedes|fills,targets,component}; correction direction means old -> replacement; references must exist and scope-match
types.State: {revision,F,N,B,C,Q,J,seen_turns,seen_receipts,dialogue}; F product negotiation facts/dispositions/offers; N policy counters; B permission/uncertainty barriers; C provisional readback certificates; Q quarantined proposals/questions; J operation journal
types.Receipt: {transport_binding,operation_id,attempt_id,body_digest,operation,classification:success|known_no_effect|unknown,source_semantics_id}; never constructed from extracted customer speech
types.Preflight: {base_revision,status:ready|reject,financial_patch,safety_patch,question_patch,quarantine_patch,errors,obligations}; ready may retain incomplete cells and require clarification; it is never bank authorization.
types.Plan: {plan_id,base_revision,guard_dependencies,effects[{operation,immutable_body,attempt_budget,body_digest}],status:prepared|dispatched|blocked|finished}; only logical planning in these cases
types.seen_turns: map turn_id -> packet_digest; same ID+same digest is replay; same ID+different digest is ingress conflict, not an accepted replay

lanes.financial: F,N and negotiation-progress flags commit as one patch only after all affected target/aggregate/component constraints are preflighted. No shared-state mutation inside per-row iteration. Existing valid pending facts remain on abort.
lanes.safety: Barrier creation/strengthening and consent invalidation are monotone within a turn and survive rejected financial preflight. Do not restore old consent by restoring the whole snapshot. A malformed whole payload creates a global uncertainty barrier without salvaging individual untrusted rows.
lanes.questions_and_quarantine: Independently understood questions remain obligations. Valid sibling proposal evidence is retained in Q with batch/source/version and uncommitted status, not installed as agreed/current F. Rejected data never creates tool parameters or refusal counters.
lanes.repair: A later repair must reference the rejected batch/affected assertions; re-resolve and revalidate the entire proposed financial patch against a new snapshot. Discard obsolete rows explicitly; never auto-promote a once-valid prefix from Q.
lanes.receipt: Receipt transitions update J/confirmed bank facts through their own revision-checked transaction. A concurrent receipt invalidates stale user-turn preflight; never overwrite confirmed bank state with an old staged copy.
lanes.error_barriers: Every rejected financial batch invalidates consent for its affected targets and blocks its queued plan; unknown/ambiguous scope blocks globally. Changed/pending/conflicting component cells revoke dependent certificates even when no permission row exists. Preserve old facts as last-known evidence, not authority to ignore the new ambiguity.

preflight_steps.reject: bad frame/overflow/duplicate inconsistent event IDs => financial patch empty, global ingress barrier, current consent invalid
unknown keys/kinds/invalid finite number/non-source identity => reject; missing is not absence

preflight_steps.writes: staged barrier and consent invalidation only
preflight_steps.rule: Any complete pause/withdraw/readback request or unfinished permission/correction puts affected targets under a barrier; unresolved scope creates global barrier. Scope uncertainty cannot be ignored because raw-copy text looks affirmative.

preflight_steps.writes: atomic assertions keyed(target,component); original aggregate constraints retained
preflight_steps.reject: any unknown/ambiguous target rejects financial patch; overlapping selectors expand before conflict checks
cycle/dangling edge/cross-component or cross-subject correction => reject; serialization is not semantic order

preflight_steps.rule: For each cell retain maximal assertions after correction edges. Distinct maximal complete values => conflict. Unresolved maximal replacement => pending. Same normalized complete value can coalesce provenance. Independent fill-need plus uniquely complete sibling closes the need; unknown replacement semantics cannot be guessed as fill.

preflight_steps.reject: any impossible total, missing allocation, stale source, conflict, recorded-product mutation or unsupported dependency => no financial patch; invalid aggregate may require clarification rather than refusal

preflight_steps.rule: Permission never becomes refusal. Preserve disjoint q refusal even if p permission pauses; count an attempt only at the unique source-defined persuasion-offer consumption step, not once per extracted row.

Union barriers from invalid/unresolved scope, financial rejection, component conflict/pending replacement and permission. Revoke certificates depending on changed cells or any affected joint target. No rejected patch can keep an old queued write enabled.

If live revision differs, return RETRY_PREFLIGHT without effects; no stale patch application. Otherwise always apply safety+questions+quarantine, and apply F/N/progress only for ready result. Assign a new state revision once.

preflight_steps.writes: logical immutable plan then at most one external dispatch
preflight_steps.rule: Source-specific priority selects next obligation after reduction. Dispatch separately revalidates source/account/term/permission revisions, identity, no unknown effect, policy, retry class and readback chronology. No tool call inside preflight/commit.

reduction_laws.cell_selection: Candidates(target,component)=maximal scoped assertions in the relation DAG. Equal normalized complete maxima collapse to one value; unequal maxima are conflict. An unresolved replacement is never overridden merely by finding an older complete value.
reduction_laws.interturn: New positively asserted terms on a later turn may supersede prior unrecorded component facts under source semantics; add explicit temporal edges in IR. Multiple incompatible assertions within one turn need an explicit relation or remain conflict. Recorded promises are immutable.
reduction_laws.fill_vs_correction: need(role=fill) can be discharged by an independent complete value for that cell. need(role=replacement, correction_of=e) remains unresolved unless a later linked completion fills it. role=unknown is conservative unresolved, not silently fill.
reduction_laws.aggregate: An aggregate T over targets U remains a joint constraint. Permit an allocation only if each A_p is explicit or uniquely source-derived (current export supports total=sum past_due => full balances), sum A_p=T, and every A_p respects per-product policy. No proportional/equal split invented. Missing allocation => clarification; impossible sum => policy rejection; both yield empty financial patch.
reduction_laws.rollback: FinancialAbort => F_after=F_before AND N_after=N_before AND progress_after=progress_before. B may grow; C may shrink; Q/questions may grow. Therefore whole-State equality is the WRONG rollback assertion.
reduction_laws.idempotence: Replaying same stable turn/event or receipt ID changes neither F/N/J nor revisions a second time. Two distinct real turns with identical words are not automatically duplicates.
reduction_laws.independence: Act permutations preserving event IDs, relation graph and target semantics must preserve normalized preflight/commit result. Arrival order of receipts, source speech turns and correction EDGE DIRECTION are meaningful and not freely permutable.

reference_pseudocode: if known turn ID and equal packet digest: return S, NO_EFFECT
if known turn ID and unequal digest: return COMMIT_REJECT(global_ingress_barrier), NO_EFFECT
if frame invalid: R = REJECT(global_ingress_barrier, empty_financial_patch)
cells = SELECT_MAXIMA_AND_FILL_NEEDS(X,G,S0.F) if no blocking type/scope/relation errors else EMPTY
errors = type_errors + scope_errors + relation_errors + CELL_CONFLICTS + ALLOCATION_ERRORS + POLICY_ERRORS
if errors: R = REJECT(safety, quarantine=X, validated_questions=E.questions, F_patch=EMPTY,N_patch=EMPTY)
if LIVE.revision != S0.revision: return RETRY_PREFLIGHT, NO_EFFECT
DISPATCH(plan,S): under serialized transition revalidate current dependencies/certificate/no-unknown/budget; freeze body; journal dispatched; invoke only allowed bank operation.
ON_RECEIPT(r,S): verify immutable operation-capsule binding; apply three-way receipt transition once with CAS; unknown != no-effect != success.

reference_error_rule: All frame/type/scope/relation exceptions return a typed reject result with no financial patch. Unknown scope/frame failures set global barrier; policy errors with known scope set affected batch barrier. No exceptions may escape after partially modifying live F/N.
fixture_notice: Numbers and D0/D1 are a synthetic finite verification domain, not customer labels, official expected outcomes, or reusable policy constants. In B3-2,50 and total1 are the review-reported counterexample; those exact payload values are retained only in the source-counterexample record. No absolute customer date/name is copied. Fixture receipt provenance is an explicit test assumption; production availability is unproven.

case_adapter_contract.inheritance: Fixture extends shallow-copies scalar state, deep-merges F/F_extra, and preserves all other base fields; case history overrides only listed fields. No fixture is a live authority claim.
case_adapter_contract.acts: Missing source_ref in a compact case is a synthetic fixture-local source reference keyed by stable act ID. Component values are already normalized. Natural-language parsing is out of scope of the cell reference.
case_adapter_contract.history: Ordered history steps are separate transactions. A packet belongs to a later logical user turn than rb0 unless it explicitly tests a same-turn/earlier reference.
case_adapter_contract.expected: All listed expected fields are conjunctive assertions. F_values is a subset assertion; equals_before compares entire named lane. Quarantined Q values are never substituted into F. logical_plan describes offline allowable dispatch only; no actual bank calls occur.
case_adapter_contract.status: ready means entire proposed F/N patch validated. Incomplete ordinary cells may commit pending status; unresolved/conflict/aggregate errors cannot commit a prefix. Rejected terms may produce source-backed clarification/counteroffer obligations, but a new counteroffer requires a separate valid state transition.
case_adapter_contract.relations: Current flat carrier does not prove correction edges by row order. If the adapter cannot establish a scoped edge, it must produce conflict/clarification. This spec does not require new learned heads or assert current producer support.
case_adapter_contract.questions: A well-framed batch may retain individually validated question obligations despite a finance-policy rejection. Unframed bytes cannot be partially salvaged into authority.
case_adapter_contract.counter_consumption: Refusal sets per-target pending obligation. A separate unique source-defined offer-consumption event spends the persuasion attempt once. No independent speech-delivery acknowledgement is assumed from a scheduled TTS string.

ignore_only: fresh local identifier spelling under consistent bijection
comparison_projection.rendering_tests: Recompute spans/source digest after punctuation transformations; equality is semantic projection with valid new bindings, not reuse of old offsets.

cell_reference.language: Python3 stdlib only; embedded mathematical specification
cell_reference.boundary: Only maximal-assertion/fill algebra on already scoped, normalized cells. Target binding, aggregate validation, whole-transaction CAS, policy, permission and receipts remain specification contracts, not implemented/verified by this small function.

permission_join.within_turn: Map barriers to severity clear<needs_fresh_readback<unresolved; take pointwise maximum over expanded target scopes. Unknown scope becomes global. Therefore complete withdrawal cannot downgrade an unfinished-permission barrier in the same packet.
permission_join.across_turns: Only the explicit later resolution/readback/confirmation transitions may lower severity. Union provenance/reasons within a turn; never choose the last permission row.
permission_join.joint_certificate: If any target in a joint certificate intersects a new barrier/error/changed component, revoke the whole certificate; retain independent target facts and refusal events.
permission_join.chronology: earlier(turn_a,turn_b) is an established event-stream ordering relation, not lexicographic or numeric comparison of opaque IDs. If order cannot be established, no confirmation certificate.

dispatch_linearization.point: In one serialized state transition, recheck plan readset/version and all guards, freeze body, and mark operation dispatched before invoking the bank tool. No tool invocation occurs during preflight.
dispatch_linearization.withdrawal_before: A withdrawal/barrier committed before this transition blocks dispatch; a previously prepared plan is not a continuing authorization.
dispatch_linearization.withdrawal_after: After dispatch starts, preserve in-flight/unknown journal status. A later withdrawal stops further unsent effects but cannot establish cancellation of the sent operation. A bound success still creates a truthful recorded fact; source disallows changing/cancelling it in-call.
dispatch_linearization.unknown: A local crash after marking dispatched is not proof the bank did nothing. Missing result is unknown and cannot be retried as failure without a source no-effect guarantee.

handoff_contract.no_new_wire_required_for_atomicity: Target expansion, all-total validation, draft-state commit and permission barrier can be implemented around current typed rows. Unencoded correction order must yield conflict; do not add a learned authority head or trust row order.
handoff_contract.required_delivery: Per case report source/implementation hashes, typed inputs, pre/post F/N/B/C/Q/J, logical calls, observed result and unexercised conditions. Preserve source witness classifications; no hosted pass-rate or all-branches claim.
handoff_contract.qualification: These finite synthetic cases are compiler/spec regressions, not reviewed training labels, calibration or blind qualification. No original expectations, candidate, guide, model or platform changes here.

verification.claim: Only embedded one-cell algebra and artifact consistency checked.27 full finite cases/15 metamorphic properties are implementer oracles, not candidate passes.

adapter_boundary: T22/T23 constrain the source-to-typed-act adapter and existing identity transition, not the one-cell financial reducer. Recipient recognition advances only to the first source-defined security question. It never establishes bank verification.
revision_assignment: The full reducer retains maximal assertion IDs/provenance. A substantive change or explicit correction creates a fresh component revision even if a later correction restores the same value. An exact event replay does not. The small cell_reference deliberately returns only selected value/status; it does not implement provenance or certificate revision assignment.
